Sandbox_SLA_tooltip: Control Survivor XP pacing, skill advancement limits, and optional Survivor Level inheritance.
Sandbox_SLA_SurvivorXpMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies Survivor XP gained from trainable skill XP. This does not change skill XP.
Sandbox_SLA_FitnessStrengthContributionP: Fitness & Strength Survivor XP contribution percentage
Sets Survivor XP from Fitness and Strength as a percentage of ordinary skill contribution before the Survivor XP multiplier. 6.7 means 6.7%%.
Sandbox_SLA_AutomaticCurveNormalization_: Balances Survivor XP from compatible custom skills using their published XP curve. Skills without a usable curve use normal contribution.
Sandbox_SLA_EnableSurvivorLevelInheritan: Allows an eligible new character to inherit part of the previous character's Survivor Level for the same player profile.
Sandbox_SLA_SurvivorLevelRetainedPercent: Percentage of the previous character's Survivor Level inherited by an eligible new character.
Sandbox_SLA_AllotmentMode_tooltip: Global shares Advancement Slots across skills. Per Skill limits Advancement Slots by skill. Free removes Advancement Slots, catch-up tracking, and recovery restrictions. Natural skill XP still grants Survivor XP.
Sandbox_SLA_GlobalAdvancementLimit_toolt: Maximum active advancements across all skills. Used only in Global mode.
Sandbox_SLA_PerSkillDefaultLimit_tooltip: Default maximum active advancements per skill. Custom skills use this value. Vanilla skills can override it below.
